children: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress is an obvious choice as interim CEO after Jensen Huang's departure, but her appointment is a stopgap, says Nic Puckrin, cross-asset analyst and founder of Coin Bureau. The question remains: Can anyone can fill Huang's boots? As an architect of the circular financing arrangements underpinning the AI boom, Huang personally helped startups secure customers and investors, while Nvidia's investments helped finance the infrastructure that drives demand for its chips, Puckrin says. If a successor can't engineer similar deals the impact could extend far beyond Nvidia's stock. The political fallout and national security investigation into the allegations that led to Huang's resignation could also affect Nvidia's chip sales to China, Puckrin says. The uncertainty is likely to weigh on Nvidia shares for some time. (fabiana.negrinochoa@wsj.com)
